Ken Bailey walked magnificently in his first Brighton, George Beecham took third place after a steady race, and John Keown backed up well. Thanks must go to those who assisted our walkers, to mention just a few, Eric & Mavis Hall, Jack Goswell, Eric Beecham, and Don Bartliff.
We congratulate Eric and Mavis Hall on their recent addition to the family.
Regretably, we must also record the death on 17th July 1998 of Rose, wife of the late Tom Morrell and mother of Mavis Hall. Rose had survived Tom by just three years and eight hours.
